defects.failing: A commit adds a file holding a NUL byte (UTF-16 text, say) with a listed name: without --text git prints 'Binary files differ' and the scan finds 0 matches. A merge's conflict resolution adds a name that a later commit removes: neither the --no-merges log nor the three-dot diff holds that line.

The title and body go into step env, so the Actions log prints them although the scan must never print the text. A re-run reuses the frozen event payload, so after an edit it scans the old title, body and base. The branch name is never scanned.

Two runs over the same project root at once (with different --out) write, read and remove the same .excavator/tmp/structure-all-chunk-<index> files, so one run merges the other's chunk or fails reading a file the other removed.

A --scan file whose files[] holds '../outside/secret.ts' or an absolute path is passed on unfiltered, and the extractor reads join(projectRoot, path), so a file outside the project is read and recorded.

When the temporary project path plus 'src/Rx.java' is 80 characters or fewer, the script prints the whole path, but the test always expects the first 80 characters plus '...', so the test fails on a short temporary directory.
